title: EM / RF HYGIENE ONBOARD SHIPS CHECK OFF LISTS

sections.title: EM / RF HYGIENE ONBOARD SHIPS CHECK OFF LISTS

fields_1.name: ship_gr_a
fields_1.label: (a) When was the last major refit (NR and above) undertaken and pre and post refit survey carried out?

fields_1.name: ship_gr_b
fields_1.label: (b) When did Naval EMC Centre undertake the last EMI / EMC survey?

fields_1.name: ship_gr_c
fields_1.label: (c) Were any modifications / A's and A's carried out on any electrical / electronic equipment since last survey? If yes, indicate details and authority, and whether NEC comments / recommendations were obtained during feasibility study.

fields_1.name: ship_gr_d
fields_1.label: (d) Any EMI problems encountered since the last survey? If yes, state the EMI problems.

cells.value: Are all movable / hinged structures (hatches and doors) bonded with Type I bond straps?

Are there any loose metallic items in vicinity of radar and communication antennas?
